title: Lucid Air 高效率電動車
summary: 以「Lucid Air 高效率電動車」為案例，逐步分析高效率電動車的多段損失與氣動協同。十個單元各有機制、定量、驗證與診斷；所有數字是教學假設，共用物理模型依案例介面選用。
summaryEn: Use Lucid Air efficient electric car to analyze Multi-stage losses and aerodynamic coordination in an efficient EV. Ten units connect mechanisms, calculations, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are teaching assumptions; shared physical models are selected for the case interfaces.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

steps.title: 使用需求與試驗邊界｜Lucid Air 高效率電動車：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Use requirements and test boundary | Lucid Air efficient electric car: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 使用需求與試驗邊界｜Lucid Air 高效率電動車 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Use requirements and test boundary | Lucid Air efficient electric car and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 案例任務：高效率電動車的多段損失與氣動協同。本單元觀察 功率模組、線束、冷卻入口與迎風投影 中與「使用需求與試驗邊界」相關的介面。車型名稱不是試驗條件；先把乘員、貨物、續航與地形需求轉成載荷表。整車的輸入質量必須包含結構、能源系統及使用載荷。
steps.instructionEn: Case task: Multi-stage losses and aerodynamic coordination in an efficient EV. In power module, harness, cooling inlet and frontal projection, inspect the interface related to “Use requirements and test boundary”. A vehicle name is not a test condition. Convert occupants, cargo, range and terrain needs into a load table; input mass must include structure, energy storage and operating payload.
steps.observation: 明示教學假設，不是 Lucid Air 高效率電動車 的原廠或實測規格。m_total=m_empty+m_payload；假設空車 1870 kg、載荷 330 kg。 計算結果 = 2200 kg。此為獨立教學工況；跨單元整合前先統一輸入、邊界及能量分配，再依模型限制解讀。
steps.observationEn: Explicit teaching assumptions, not manufacturer or measured specifications for Lucid Air efficient electric car. m_total=m_empty+m_payload; assume empty mass 1870 kg and payload 330 kg. Result = 2200 kg. This is an independent teaching operating point; reconcile inputs, boundaries and energy allocation before integrating units, then interpret within the model limits.
steps.failure: 若能耗或軸重突然改變，先核對是否把總重又加了一次電池或貨物；再比較量測日期與配置版本。
steps.failureEn: If energy use or axle load suddenly changes, first check whether the total already included the battery or cargo, then compare measurement dates and configuration versions.
steps.check: 核對每一項載荷只計入一次；用同一資料版本計算空載與滿載，保留被排除的拖車、乘員或附件。 將證據連回本案例的 功率模組、線束、冷卻入口與迎風投影，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
steps.checkEn: Check that every load is counted once; calculate empty and laden conditions from the same data version and list excluded trailers, people or accessories. Link evidence to this case’s power module, harness, cooling inlet and frontal projection; a photograph establishes visible arrangement, not the measurement required here.

steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Battery energy and series/parallel architecture | Lucid Air efficient electric car and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 案例任務：高效率電動車的多段損失與氣動協同。本單元觀察 功率模組、線束、冷卻入口與迎風投影 中與「電池能量與串並聯架構」相關的介面。額定電壓乘容量只是能量近似；串聯提高電壓，並聯提高 Ah，實際可用能量另受電壓曲線、溫度與保護窗口限制。
steps.instructionEn: Case task: Multi-stage losses and aerodynamic coordination in an efficient EV. In power module, harness, cooling inlet and frontal projection, inspect the interface related to “Battery energy and series/parallel architecture”. Nominal voltage times capacity approximates energy; series raises voltage and parallel raises Ah, while usable energy also depends on voltage curve, temperature and protection window.
steps.observation: 明示教學假設，不是 Lucid Air 高效率電動車 的原廠或實測規格。E≈V Q；假設 V=400 V、容量 Q=100 Ah，換算 J 乘 3600。 計算結果 = 1.44e+08 J。此為獨立教學工況；跨單元整合前先統一輸入、邊界及能量分配，再依模型限制解讀。
steps.observationEn: Explicit teaching assumptions, not manufacturer or measured specifications for Lucid Air efficient electric car. E≈V Q; assume V=400 V and capacity Q=100 Ah; multiply Wh by 3600 for J. Result = 1.44e+08 J. This is an independent teaching operating point; reconcile inputs, boundaries and energy allocation before integrating units, then interpret within the model limits.

knowledge.textEn: With correct nominal capacity but shorter range, inspect usable window, cold conditions, accessories and measurement boundary without changing protective limits.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在紙面示意、試算表或自行準備的離線教學模型中完成：以虛擬單體卡片組成串並聯表，計算 V、Ah 與 J；對同能量不同電壓架構說明電流與絕緣需求的取捨。 交付檔請標上 c223、單元 2、輸入條件與資料版本。
knowledge.textEn: Complete in a paper diagram, spreadsheet or separately prepared offline teaching model: Arrange virtual cell cards into a series/parallel table and compute V, Ah and J; explain current versus insulation tradeoffs at equal energy. Label the evidence c223, unit 2, input conditions and data version.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
額定 kWh 就是每次行駛都可完全取出的能量。
容量數字正確但續航偏短，查可用窗口、低溫、附件負載與量測電量邊界，不直接改動保護設定。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Nominal kWh is fully extractable on every trip.
With correct nominal capacity but shorter range, inspect usable window, cold conditions, accessories and measurement boundary without changing protective limits.
quiz.explanation: 容量數字正確但續航偏短，查可用窗口、低溫、附件負載與量測電量邊界，不直接改動保護設定。 先核對單體、模組及整包計數，再以電壓—電量積分與額定近似比較；標出保留 SOC 窗口。 將證據連回本案例的 功率模組、線束、冷卻入口與迎風投影，註明照片只能證明可見配置，不能代替本步量測。
quiz.explanationEn: With correct nominal capacity but shorter range, inspect usable window, cold conditions, accessories and measurement boundary without changing protective limits. Reconcile cell, module and pack counts, then compare voltage–charge integration with the nominal estimate; mark the reserved SOC window. Link evidence to this case’s power module, harness, cooling inlet and frontal projection; a photograph establishes visible arrangement, not the measurement required here.
